trimmedBy: node trim-captures.mjs (JSON.parse, whole-record selection by id (legal object kept verbatim as element 0), regex redaction of e-mail addresses and separator-bearing phone numbers inside string values, JSON.stringify); never a byte cut
notes: Capture had 100 elements (1 legal object + 99 jobs); kept the legal object + 6 jobs. robots.txt (User-agent *) allows / and sets Crawl-delay: 1; it does not disallow /api. The legal object's own text is the terms: link back to the Remote OK URL "with follow, and without nofollow" and mention Remote OK as the source, else API access is suspended; do not use the logo. No pagination: one request returns the latest ~100 jobs. E-mail addresses and phone numbers inside string values were replaced by a parser; personal NAMES in free-text descriptions cannot be found by a parser and were not redacted (records were chosen with short descriptions to limit exposure).
